interpretation: Policy below describes authored current behavior, not a passed historical proposal. Source pointers and topology are required bounded contract ownership; explicitly returned snapshots and active FD buffers are transient ownership, never lookup caches.

read_protocol: Resolve only pinned declared locator and validate identity/public exposure policy.
Read one bounded locked committed snapshot and decode fresh owned value; verify active catalog before/after live read.
Refresh discovery shape independently; snapshot existing open file/directory version until release.
Fail unavailable/pending/malformed/invalid/drift explicitly; no schema-template/stale-value/null fallback for authoritative reads.
write_protocol: Check exact per-FD UID/access/local writable class and bounded input before acceptance.
Workspace: single local object writer; checked expected-object CAS under durable store lock; complete candidate/public constraints and immutable base; atomic file publication.
Call: exact sealed args and returns contract admission, identity/grants, canonical UUID reservation and confirmed durable attempt before effect.
Cancellation-owned backend commit must precede change notification; validate declared domain output, append durable linked terminal and journal status before completed receipt.
Unknown effects remain unknown; preserve operation UUID and query only declared caller-scoped proof recovery, never resubmit automatically.

memory_strategy.fd_ownership: Capacity charged before vector growth; RAII charge remains until descriptor and any admitted worker drop. Freed source decodes are not memoized.
memory_strategy.scope: Limits bound serialized/source/staging/topology ownership, not every allocator/native backend or system-wide audit Vec. Large domain method buffers remain each backend owner's responsibility.

concurrency.callbacks: Backend execution is asynchronous relative to FUSE loop; at most four jobs and32 per-FD flush waiters.
concurrency.cancellation: Exact elevation arguments are consumed inside owned task after cancellable compliance/session attribution and capacity admission, then dropped before audit. Dropping FD/caller does not erase admitted reservation/attempt/backend/terminal and never causes replay.
concurrency.cross_process: Workspace object CAS checks expected hash under existing exclusive writer lock; no local mutex alone is claimed cross-process protection.
concurrency.cross_store: Cozo journal, audit timing trail, and SHM/filesystem owners do not form one invented atomic transaction; failed uncertainty remains unknown.

identity_rules: Mounted mode declaration and UUID are provenance, not credentials; source authentication stays bridge.
Local UID ownership supplements kernel/default_permissions; it does not replace caller identity or grant capability.
No grants broadened, no alternate transport, no principal/session selectors in receipt arguments.
Private Cozo journal namespace receiver-derived and disjoint from public domain document keys; generic cognitive DB alias rejected.

validation.sequence: source freeze -> preparatory generation -> native GNU release build -> snapshot/send-receive deployment -> tests and /verify
validation.historical: Prior audit/component receipts retained under verification.historical only.

remaining_limits: Existing global audit EventChain lifetime RAM growth.
No raw mmap/watch/arbitrary node mutation/cancellation rollback guarantees.
